messages:
nina: seeing a brief spike of 5xx from embeddings at 04:12 UTC, looks like migration sidecar hang. We need a hotpatch to restart the worker and flip the migration flag. Request expedited approvals (SRE + Product). Preferred window 04:30-05:00 UTC. deploybot, please intake.

deploybot: Intake acknowledged. Hotpatch template: image=redwood/embeds:2026-03-hotpatch-mig2, canary=10% for 4m. Required approvers: @sre_lead + @product_pm. Provide runbook and rollback plan to proceed.

sre_lead: I'm oncall. Share rollback one-liner and abort thresholds. I'll run staging smoke and sign off if green.

nina: Runbook (short): 1) Kick canary 10% for 4m. 2) Monitor errors via /dash?svc=embeds&window=4m and logs for sidecar panics. Abort if errors >0.9% OR p95 increases >200ms. 3) Rollback: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embeds embeds=redwood/embeds:2026.03-stable && kubectl rollout status deploy/embeds` 4) Post release note.

product_pm: Product ack - no schema changes. Draft release note: "Hotfix: restart embeddings worker and toggle migration flag to remediate intermittent 5xxs. No API changes."

sre_lead: Staging smoke passed at 04:25 UTC (healthcheck ok, kv warm). Approve after canary observed.

deploybot: Manual gate created. Approvals required: `/deploy approve 6601012345 --by @sre_lead` and `/deploy approve 6601012345 --by @product_pm`. To start: `/deploy kick 6601012345 --window 04:30-05:00 --manual-gate`.

jay: I'll watch metrics and be ready to rollback if needed. Put me on the bridge when kicking.

nina: Kicking canary 04:31 UTC -> cb-6601012345. Initial canary metrics: errors=0.12%, p95 +35ms.

sre_lead: Canary green from SRE. `/deploy approve 6601012345 --by @sre_lead`

product_pm: Approving now. `/deploy approve 6601012345 --by @product_pm`

deploybot: Both approvals received. Promoting to 100% at 04:36 UTC. Rolling update in progress.

deploybot: Rollout complete 04:39 UTC. Post-rollout metrics: errors ~0.1%, p95 within expected. No rollback executed.

ops_watcher: Monitoring window +20m, all stable so far.

nina: Posting release note to #release-notes and closing thread after monitor. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
